aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In a confined space, four strangers are forced into a live online trial where they must navigate a high-stakes game of survival between truth and death.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Four individuals with unknown identities wake up trapped inside a claustrophobic enclosure, only to discover they are the subjects of a live broadcasted online trial. As the anonymous host demands answers, the captives must confront hidden secrets and twisted revelations while trying to outsmart a deadly ticking clock. Tensions escalate rapidly as every vote from the online audience brings them closer to either execution or escape. Ultimately, they must untangle the mysterious web connecting them all before time runs out.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The narrative follows two men and two women who regain consciousness in an isolated, heavily monitored room with no memory of how they arrived. They are immediately confronted by a sinister entity conducting a live stream, where an online public serves as judge and jury. To survive each round of the trial, the participants are forced to uncover their hidden identities and reveal the dark connections binding them together. As the stream attracts millions of viewers, the stakes grow increasingly lethal, with wrong answers carrying immediate fatal consequences. Misdirection and paranoia thrive within the group as each person tries to protect their own secrets while exposing the others. Clues dropped throughout the game suggest that their captivity is not random, but a meticulously planned act of retribution. As the mystery unravels, the boundary between victims and perpetrators begins to blur in front of a bloodthirsty digital audience. Facing an imminent deadline, the survivors must execute a risky, desperate escape attempt before the final verdict is cast.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: User Not Found is a tense crime-mystery drama centered on four enigmatic individuals thrust into a high-stakes, broadcasted survival game. Trapped in a confined location, two men and two women are forced to participate in a live online trial where the public votes on their fate based on revelations about their pasts. As secrecy gives way to desperation, the psychological thriller examines themes of internet vigilantism, accountability, and human resilience under extreme pressure.

story_structure.climax: A final, extreme dilemma pushes the surviving participants to make an irreversible choice between self-preservation, revealing the ultimate secret, and executing a desperate escape.
story_structure.conflict: The participants are pitted against each other and the trial's anonymous mastermind, forced to expose secrets and vote on life-and-death decisions under tight constraints.
story_structure.resolution: The aftermath of the trial is revealed, dealing with the fallout of the exposed truth, the fate of the participants, and the ultimate exposure or survival of the game's architect.
story_structure.introduction: Four strangers awaken in a confined setting with concealed identities, only to discover they have been forced into a high-stakes online trial broadcast to a live audience.
story_structure.risingAction: Tensions spike as hidden connections surface, physical escape attempts grow increasingly hazardous, and the deadly consequences of the trial intensify with every revealed truth.
